:_mod-docs-content-type: REFERENCE

[id="model-cache-configuration-reference_{context}"]
= Model cache configuration reference

[role="_abstract"]
You can configure model cache by editing the `inferenceservice-config` ConfigMap and by creating `LocalModelCache`, `LocalModelNodeGroup`, and `ClusterStorageContainer` custom resource definitions (CRDs).
The following tables describe the available fields for each resource.

[id="inferenceservice-config-localmodel-fields_{context}"]
== inferenceservice-config ConfigMap localModel fields

The `localModel` section in the `inferenceservice-config` ConfigMap controls the overall model cache behavior.

.localModel configuration fields
[cols="2,1,1,3", options="header"]
|===
|Field
|Type
|Required
|Description

|`enabled`
|Boolean
|Yes
|Set to `true` to enable model cache. Default is `false`.

|`jobNamespace`
|String
|Yes
|The namespace where model download jobs run. You must create this namespace before caching models.

|`defaultJobImage`
|String
|No
|The container image used for model download jobs. In disconnected environments, this image must be available from a mirrored registry.

|`fsGroup`
|Integer
|No
|The group ID for file system permissions on downloaded model files. Set to `1000` to match the default user in the download job container.

|`jobTTLSecondsAfterFinished`
|Integer
|No
|The number of seconds after a download job completes before the job is automatically deleted.

|`reconcilationFrequencyInSecs`
|Integer
|No
|The frequency in seconds at which the controller reconciles model cache state.

|`disableVolumeManagement`
|Boolean
|No
|Set to `true` to disable automatic persistent volume and persistent volume claim management. Default is `false`.
|===

[id="localmodelcache-crd-fields_{context}"]
== LocalModelCache CRD fields

The `LocalModelCache` resource defines a model to cache on local node storage or network volumes.
This is a cluster-scoped resource.

.LocalModelCache spec fields
[cols="2,1,1,3", options="header"]
|===
|Field
|Type
|Required
|Description

|`sourceModelUri`
|String
|Yes
|The URI of the model in remote storage, such as `hf://meta-llama/Llama-3-70B`. This field is immutable after creation.

|`modelSize`
|Quantity
|Yes
|The estimated size of the model, such as `140Gi`. The model size must not exceed the `storageLimit` of the target node group when using local disk caching.

|`nodeGroups`
|List of strings
|Conditional
|The names of the `LocalModelNodeGroup` resources where the model should be cached. Required for local disk caching. Do not specify when using `storageClassName`.

|`storageClassName`
|String
|Conditional
|The name of the `StorageClass` to use for network volume provisioning. Required for network volume caching. Do not specify when using `nodeGroups`.

|`serviceAccountName`
|String
|No
|The service account to use for credential lookup during model download.

|`storage.key`
|String
|No
|The storage key in the secret for this model.

|`storage.parameters`
|Map
|No
|Parameters to override the default storage credentials and configuration.
|===

.LocalModelCache status fields
[cols="2,1,3", options="header"]
|===
|Field
|Type
|Description

|`nodeStatus`
|Map
|A map of node names to download status. Possible values: `NodeNotReady`, `NodeDownloadPending`, `NodeDownloading`, `NodeDownloaded`, `NodeDownloadError`. Applies to local disk caching.

|`copies.available`
|Integer
|The number of nodes where the model is available locally.

|`copies.total`
|Integer
|The total number of nodes where the model is expected to be downloaded, including nodes that are not ready.

|`copies.failed`
|Integer
|The number of nodes where the download failed.

|`inferenceServices`
|List
|A list of `InferenceService` resources that are using this cached model, identified by namespace and name.

|`llmInferenceServices`
|List
|A list of `LLMInferenceService` resources that are using this cached model, identified by namespace and name.
|===

[id="localmodelnodegroup-crd-fields_{context}"]
== LocalModelNodeGroup CRD fields

The `LocalModelNodeGroup` resource defines a group of nodes for model caching and the storage configuration for those nodes.
This is a cluster-scoped resource.
Node groups are required for local disk caching but are not required for network volume caching.

.LocalModelNodeGroup spec fields
[cols="2,1,1,3", options="header"]
|===
|Field
|Type
|Required
|Description

|`storageLimit`
|Quantity
|Yes
|The maximum total storage for cached models per node in this node group, such as `500Gi`.

|`persistentVolumeSpec`
|PersistentVolumeSpec
|Yes
|The persistent volume specification used to create PVs for downloading models. Includes `local.path` for the storage path and `nodeAffinity` for targeting specific nodes.

|`persistentVolumeClaimSpec`
|PersistentVolumeClaimSpec
|Yes
|The persistent volume claim specification used to create PVCs for download jobs and in inference service namespaces.
|===

.LocalModelNodeGroup status fields
[cols="2,1,3", options="header"]
|===
|Field
|Type
|Description

|`used`
|Quantity
|The storage space used by cached models on nodes in this node group.

|`available`
|Quantity
|The available storage space on nodes in this node group.
|===

[id="localmodelnode-crd-fields_{context}"]
== LocalModelNode CRD fields

The `LocalModelNode` resource represents a single node that participates in model caching.
The controller creates one `LocalModelNode` resource per node.

.LocalModelNode status fields
[cols="2,1,3", options="header"]
|===
|Field
|Type
|Description

|`modelStatus`
|Map
|A map of model names to download status on this node. Possible values: `ModelDownloadPending`, `ModelDownloading`, `ModelDownloaded`, `ModelDownloadError`.
|===

[id="clusterstoragecontainer-model-cache-fields_{context}"]
== ClusterStorageContainer fields for model cache

When using a `ClusterStorageContainer` to provide download credentials for model cache, set the `workloadType` field to `localModelDownloadJob`.

.ClusterStorageContainer model cache fields
[cols="2,1,3", options="header"]
|===
|Field
|Type
|Description

|`workloadType`
|String
|Set to `localModelDownloadJob` to apply this storage container configuration to model cache download jobs.

|`supportedUriFormats`
|List
|A list of URI format matchers that determine which model URIs this storage container handles. Each entry can specify a `prefix`, such as `hf://`.
|===

[id="model-cache-node-label_{context}"]
== Node label for model cache

For Kustomize-based installations, each target node must be labeled with the following label to enable the model cache agent DaemonSet scheduling:

.Model cache node label
[cols="1,1,2", options="header"]
|===
|Label key
|Label value
|Description

|`kserve/localmodel`
|`worker`
|Enables the model cache agent DaemonSet to schedule pods on the node. Required for Kustomize-based installations. Helm-based installations use persistent volume `nodeAffinity` instead.
|===
